Well-known Usenet providers come as tiles, the Apps page offers the Flatpak, and KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.3.1.

## ✨ Added

- **Well-known Usenet providers come as tiles.** Under Accounts, "Add a server" offers ten of them, Eweka and Newshosting among them. Pick yours and its server and encrypted port are filled in, along with the connection count where the provider states one, so only your login is left. "Other server" opens the empty form for any other provider.
- **The Apps page offers the Flatpak** next to Windows, macOS and Linux, for x64 and ARM.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Rules can be edited and removed in the Graphic view.** Point at a rule or reach it with the keyboard, and a pencil and a bin appear right after its name. On a touch screen they stay in view.
- **The browser extension's video button says why a send failed.** Point at "Could not send" and it tells you whether the relay could not be reached or your instance did not answer in time.

## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.3.1 everywhere,** and the Version card names it. Every selector keeps to one row: where its labels do not fit, it shows its glyphs alone, or turns into a dropdown if it has no glyphs. In the phone app a package with its files open can be moved to either end of the list, and the rows sway gently while one is held.
- **Stop at the first matching rule is a switch like every other,** with its name at the start of the row and the switch at the end.
